resource.name: fotufilm-engine
resource.creator: DhaliwalX
resource.category: Color grading, DCTLs, film looks, and color science
resource.description: Film simulation engine with a Resolve OpenFX plugin and Mac app. Stable release v1.7.1-build12; v1.8-alpha adds scanned-negative import and sampled film curves. Includes film profiles with separate CC BY-SA terms.
resource.platformNotes: Mac app requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+; plugin guide also documents universal builds. Exact Resolve edition/version is not established.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Uses Resolve GPU frames on Apple Silicon for faster renders. Revises scanned-negative balancing, film chemistry, print surfaces and histogram display; existing negative and color-film grades can render differently. macOS packages are signed and notarized. Linux desktop/Resolve and Android builds remain alpha, with platform-specific playback and export limits.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Adds an Android alpha for the standalone editor. Revises color-negative rendering and mist filters, and fixes zoomed photo previews.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Fixes Linux startup on distributions without OpenEXR 3.1 and restores the AV1 HEIF decoder. macOS artifacts remain 1.14.1; Linux app and plugin remain alpha.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Speeds up opening library photos, supports folder-wide photo strips and multi-photo preset editing, and fixes repeating grain patches. Linux app and Resolve plugin remain alpha.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Adds Lab Scan finishing controls, blends film-grain patches to remove grid seams and provides a Linux alpha build.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Adds negative scanning controls and closer Fujifilm slide-film rendering for the Mac app and Resolve plugins.
changes: Adds tone, straighten, frame and light-frame controls for scanned negatives.
Improves Fujifilm slide-film colour rendering; Final Cut Pro lens flare follows the selected stage.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Revises cinema-print timing, source illumination and channel contrast behavior. Existing edits may render differently.
changes: Corrects print-layer sensitivity and density targets.
Defaults source illumination to Stock Native, with daylight, tungsten and custom choices.
Separates source light, viewing illumination and print development.
Makes Channel Contrast Match optional and off by default while preserving saved nonzero settings.
